inspirationNote: Destructive variant uses the token text-destructive-foreground where shadcn's own source hardcodes text-white -- adico is more token-compliant here, not a gap. Verified variant previously hardcoded a fixed emerald so the checkmark badge would read consistently across every theme; `fix-component-defects-and-tone-variants` reverses that call now that a real `--success` theme token exists -- a badge variant refusing to theme while every other variant does was judged worse than the green shifting slightly across palettes, and the inconsistency was itself confusing. Verified now tracks `--success` like Destructive already tracks `--destructive`. dioxus-components uses CSS modules (external style.css files), not Tailwind, so no Tailwind class-level comparison is possible there.
